name: island-estate
description: 私人海岛庄园 three.js 场景：程序化地形、写实植被、第一人称漫游（Bun + TypeScript，构建为单 HTML + 外置资源）

scripts.check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:terrain && bun run test:shore && bun run test:invariants && bun run test:baselines && bun run test:regression && bun run test:ecology && bun run test:visual && bun run patrol:quick && python3 tests/scene_audit.py --strict
scripts.test:drive: python3 tests/drive_test.py && python3 tests/boat_test.py && python3 tests/cruise_test.py && python3 tests/heli_test.py
scripts.test:perf: python3 tests/audit.py q=high && python3 tests/audit.py q=low
